product_wide_rationale: Moves Concord development coordination into Concord after the issue #600 bootstrap release while preserving GitHub planning and merge authority, replacement-readiness evidence, and Advance reference-only status.
summary: Concord owns its development workflow after issue #600 while GitHub retains planning, review, and merge authority. It supersedes CD-0010's self-hosting prohibition and the equivalent CD-0088 D5 restatement.
title: Concord development coordination
